item.title: I am a programmer, not a rubber-stamp that approves Copilot generated code
item.description:
📝 When CTOs or project managers suggest programmers in their team to use AI assistance from copilot, chatgpt or other LLMs to improve productivity, it’s totally understandable. If the essence of programming shifts from creating to merely approving, we risk losing not just a profession, but a craft. tagged under: programming.
